def.brief: Metadata and documentation only, under README Versioning and AGENTS.md: (1) the five authoritative version values become 2.0.0 — plugin.json, .claude-plugin/plugin.json, .codex-plugin/plugin.json, and in .claude-plugin/marketplace.json both metadata.version and dwitbuk's plugins[].version; .agents/plugins/marketplace.json keeps having no version field. The major bump is the dropped Python 3.9/3.10 support (engines python >=3.11), plus the record-path and late-eyes changes since 1.16.0. (2) README is timeless: no 'currently' or present-tense statements about this release; facts stated as facts. (3) Docs consistency: Install, Versioning, Release and adoption, the manifests' engines and the Self-check agree. hunsu.json/hunsu.lock.json keep declaring the installed 1.16.0 — this project does not adopt the new version. No runtime change, so no full suite; checked by diff, JSON parse, link check and git diff --check.
